feeds.title: 3DownNation
feeds.description: 3DownNation is a website dedicated to covering all things Canadian football. Founded in 2015 by veteran CFL writer Drew Edwards while reporting for the Hamilton Spectator, ownership of the site was transferred from Torstar Corporation to its contributors in January 2019 and subsequently sold to Catena Media in March 2022.

feeds.title: CFL.ca
feeds.description: CFL is the official website of the Canadian Football League. It is a professional sports league in Canada that is dedicated to Canadian football. It is the highest level of competition for football in Canada and features nine teams from different cities across the country. The blogs share information related to Canadian football, including news and updates about the CFL teams, players, and upcoming games. The blog provides game schedules, scores, and statistics, allowing fans to stay up-to-date with their favorite teams and players.

feeds.title: Canadian Sport Scene
feeds.description: Canadian Sport Scene is a sports news website that focuses on Canadian athletes and teams. The site was created in 2017 with the mission of celebrating Canadian sports success on the international stage. Their blog covers a wide range of sports, including hockey, soccer, basketball, baseball, and more. It also features news on Canadian athletes who are competing in international competitions, such as the Olympics and the World Cup.

feeds.title: Canada Sports Betting
feeds.description: Welcome to Canada Sports Betting! For over a decade, we have been a one-stop source for all things related to the online Sportsbook, Casino, Poker, and Racebook betting industry. We also specialize in delivering well-researched previews of global sporting events plus the associated betting odds and predictions. We top it off with proprietary educational features that help Canadians understand the fast-moving online wagering world.

feeds.title: FDS
feeds.description: First Down Sports Podcast is a sports podcast that covers topics such as CFL, NFL, USports Football, and local sports across the Maritimes. It is hosted by Wray Dunn and Andy Jardine, who are passionate about sports and share their opinions and insights.

feeds.title: Sport for Life Blog
feeds.description: Sport for Life Blog is a Canadian organization that aims to develop physical literacy and deliver quality sports for people of all ages and abilities. Their blog features articles on topics such as physical education, Indigenous sport, coaching, health, and more. They also share stories of how their programs and initiatives have impacted the lives of participants and communities

feeds.title: The Sport Information Resource Centre Blog
feeds.description: Sport Information Resource Center is a committed team of professionals dedicated to advancing Canada's sport and physical activity sector through knowledge and engagement. They take pride in driving change through research and evidence and serving as Canada's thought leaders in sport.SIRC blogs and articles provide evidence-based and actionable insight from sports researchers and thought leaders to advance Canada's sport system.

feeds.title: Adrenalin
feeds.description: Canadian Sport Adrenalin Magazine is a Canadian publication focused on extreme sports and adventure lifestyles. The magazine covers a wide range of sports and activities such as extreme sports which include snowboarding, skateboarding, surfing, and outdoor adventures like mountain biking, rock climbing, hiking, and other thrilling experiences.

feeds.title: PRSVRE
feeds.description: Founded by Dashawn Stephens in 2019, PRSVRE Media Group is Canada's largest media source for university sports news, stories, and more. PRSVRE provides news related to sports leagues and events, especially Canadian university sports. You can find articles, stories, podcasts, videos, and more on their website.

feeds.title: Sportsnet
feeds.description: Sportsnet is your ultimate guide for the latest sports news, scores, standings, video highlights and more. Catch up to the minute sports headlines, news, results, sports standings, forums and blogs. Sportsnet connects Canadian sports fans to their favourite teams and athletes using four platforms: TV, Radio, Online and Mobile. Sportsnet delivers storytelling on a local, regional, national and global level.

feeds.title: Craft Sports Canada Blog
feeds.description: Craft Sports Canada is a company that sells outdoor apparel and gear. Their blog covers a variety of topics related to outdoor activities, such as hiking, biking, camping, and skiing. The most recent blog post is about gravel riding, which is a type of cycling that takes place on rough roads. The blog also includes product reviews, gear guides, and travel inspiration.

feeds.title: All-Canadian Sports Network
feeds.description: The All-Canadian Sports Network (ACSN) is the by-product of over eight years of initiative, a significant amount of trial and error, many sleepless nights, and a desire to build one's own experience in the Sports Media industry.

feeds.title: Canadian Sport Centre Manitoba Blog
feeds.description: Canadian Sport Centre Manitoba (CSCM) is a high-performance sport institute that provides support to current and aspiring Olympic and Paralympic athletes training in Manitoba. Their blog provides information on the CSCM's programs, services, and facilities, as well as news and updates on Manitoban athletes.

feeds.title: The GIST of It
feeds.description: The GIST of It is a twice-weekly podcast on what's going on in the sports world. Hosts Ellen Hyslop and Stephanie Rotz discuss current sports topics and how they intersect with pop culture and social issues, covering everything from major league season previews to calling out the sexist BS we see in sports daily. Expect a hilarious yet informative conversation with a refreshing female perspective on the world of sports.

feeds.title: Sport Law Blog
feeds.description: At Sport Law, we are a diverse team of experts from a wide variety of backgrounds and disciplines, and we are all connected by our love of sport. This shared passion brings us together to offer holistic care and unprecedented clarity to leaders seeking to grow and advance their sport.

feeds.title: Toronto Sports Blog
feeds.description: Toronto Sports is a Toronto based sports news and media site that covers various sports topics, such as the FIFA World Cup 2022, the NHL, the NBA, and more. The site features articles, videos, podcasts, and social media posts about various sports topics, such as the FIFA World Cup 2022, NHL, NBA, NFL, MLB and other top sorts in the world.

feeds.title: Tennis Canada
feeds.description: Tennis Canada is a non-profit organization that was established in 1890 with the goal of promoting and advancing tennis in Canada. Their vision is to become a leading tennis nation globally, and they place great importance on teamwork, passion, integrity, innovation, and excellence. The National Bank Open presented by Rogers WTA and ATP Tour events, as well as several other ATP and ITF sanctioned professional tournaments, are operated by Tennis Canada. They also offer financial support to four other professional tournaments in Canada.
